props.name: center
props.comment: `[lat, lng]`. Read once at mount. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.

props.name: zoom
props.comment: Read once at mount. Defaults to 13.

props.name: height
props.comment: In pixels, or any CSS length. Defaults to 300.

props.name: mapStyle
props.comment:
A MapLibre style URL, or a style object such as `rasterTileStyle(...)`.
Read once at mount. Defaults to the one from `MapsProvider`.

props.name: scrollZoom
props.comment: Zoom with the mouse wheel. Defaults to true.
